from.place: ## Proof, first sentence: the conductor equality in Varieties Remark 09NW used in the extension-by-zero argument

title: On a reduced scheme the ideal of the other components meets a component trivially
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-reduced-scheme] whose underlying space is the union of finitely many irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] $Z_1,\ldots,Z_r$, each with its reduced closed subscheme structure [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $i_1:Z_1\hookrightarrow Y$ be the inclusion, with ideal sheaf $\mathcal J_1\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Let $Z\subset Y$ be the reduced closed subscheme supported on $Z_2\cup\cdots\cup Z_r$ ($Z=\emptyset$ if $r=1$), with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$, and let $\mathcal I_1\subseteq\mathcal O_{Z_1}$ be the image of $i_1^*\mathcal I\to i_1^*\mathcal O_Y=\mathcal O_{Z_1}$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then $\mathcal I\cap\mathcal J_1=0$, i.e. $\mathcal I(U)\cap\mathcal J_1(U)=0$ in $\mathcal O_Y(U)$ for every open $U\subseteq Y$. Moreover, for every invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal M$ [def-sc-invertible-module] and every $m\ge0$, writing $\mathcal I\mathcal M^{\otimes m}\subseteq\mathcal M^{\otimes m}$ for the image of $\mathcal I\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}\mathcal M^{\otimes m}\to\mathcal M^{\otimes m}$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and $\mathcal I_1(\mathcal M|_{Z_1})^{\otimes m}$ for the corresponding image on $Z_1$, where $\mathcal M|_{Z_1}=i_1^*\mathcal M$, the restriction map $\Gamma(U,\mathcal I\mathcal M^{\otimes m})\to\Gamma(U\cap Z_1,\mathcal I_1(\mathcal M|_{Z_1})^{\otimes m})$ is bijective for every open $U\subseteq Y$.

source.place: Varieties Remark 09NW (varieties-remark-conductor): for a reduced ring $A$ and ideals $I,J$ with $V(I)\cup V(J)=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $I\cap J=0$, $I\to IB$ ($B=A/J$) is an isomorphism and $IP=I(P/JP)$ for projective $P$; as used in the proof of Lemma 09NX (varieties-lemma-dim-1-noetherian-reduced-separated-has-ample), display $\Gamma(X,\mathcal I\mathcal L^{\otimes m})=\Gamma(Z_1,\mathcal I_1\mathcal L_1^{\otimes m})$

proof.text: For an arbitrary open U and a section s in both kernel ideals, show that its basic open is empty. A point of the support of either ideal lifts through its subscheme immersion; pulling back the basic open gives the basic open of the zero section, since mem_idealOfOpens_iff kills s there. The component cover and hZ put every point in the range, hence the kernel support, of either i(a) or j. Thus the basic open is empty. Reducedness and Mathlib basicOpen_eq_bot_iff imply s=0. This is exactly the local avoid argument in Lean; no affine reduction is used.

Apply lem-sc-closed-immersion-disjoint-ideal-twist to the distinguished component immersion i(a), the ideal j.ker, and the zero-intersection equality just proved. Its multiplication images, chosen pullback adjunction, arbitrary tensor-power comparison e, and sectionwise bijectivity are definitionally the second conjunct of the item.

lean.statement: theorem conductorIdealZeroIntersection {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] (C : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ b : ι, C b ⟶ Y) [∀ b : ι, IsReduced (C b)] [∀ b : ι, IsClosedImmersion (i b)] (hcomponents : ∀ b : ι, Set.range (i b) ∈ irreducibleComponents Y) (hdistinct : Function.Injective fun b : ι => Set.range (i b)) (hcover : (⋃ b : ι, Set.range (i b)) = Set.univ) (a : ι) {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Z] (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j] (hZ : Set.range j = ⋃ b : ι, ⋃ (_ : b ≠ a), Set.range (i b)) : let I : Y.IdealSheafData := j.ker let J₁ : Y.IdealSheafData := (i a).ker let adj := Classical.choice (Modules.nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction (i a)) let φ := (adj.homEquiv I.toModules (SheafOfModules.unit (C a).ringCatSheaf)).symm (I.toModulesι ≫ SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (i a).toRingCatSheafHom) (∀ U : Y.Opens, I.idealOfOpens U ⊓ J₁.idealOfOpens U = ⊥) ∧ ∀ (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (m : ℕ) (e : (Modules.tensorPullback (i a)).obj (M.tensorPow m) ≅ ((Modules.tensorPullback (i a)).obj M).tensorPow m), let μ := I.toModulesι ▷ M.tensorPow m ≫ (λ_ (M.tensorPow m)).hom let μ₁ := image.ι φ ▷ ((Modules.tensorPullback (i a)).obj M).tensorPow m ≫ (λ_ (((Modules.tensorPullback (i a)).obj M).tensorPow m)).hom ∃ ρ : image μ ⟶ (Modules.pushforward (i a)).obj (image μ₁), ρ ≫ (Modules.pushforward (i a)).map (image.ι μ₁) = image.ι μ ≫ adj.unit.app (M.tensorPow m) ≫ (Modules.pushforward (i a)).map e.hom ∧ ∀ U : Y.Opens, Function.Bijective (ρ.app U)
